products.name: TruLens
products.note: Open-source LLM evaluation via feedback functions; RAG Triad of groundedness, context relevance, answer relevance; OpenTelemetry tracing

profile_text.body:
TruLens is an open-source evaluation and tracing library for AI agents, developed under the TruEra project and now associated with Snowflake. The project's website describes TruLens as instrumenting AI agents with OpenTelemetry, scoring every step with benchmarked LLM judges, and identifying which version of an agent to ship. It positions itself as a tool for finding where agents fail and where cost can be reduced without losing quality.

The core technical approach centers on a RAG Triad of three feedback functions: groundedness, context relevance, and answer relevance. These feedback functions are used to evaluate retrieval-augmented generation pipelines and broader agent workflows. The library is OpenTelemetry-native, meaning it integrates with that open standard for distributed tracing rather than requiring a proprietary instrumentation layer.

The site's held facts list TruLens under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are recorded for this entry.
